jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• 
Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• 
Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• 
Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• 
Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• 
Deliver measurable impact: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note this role is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• 
Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• 
Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• 
Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• 
Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• 
Structured communicator: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

What we offer

At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• 
Build deep functional expertise: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• 
Hands-on from day one: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• 
Continuous development: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• 
High-trust culture: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• 
International environment: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

Make your next move matter.

How to apply

Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027.

About Implement

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

jobs.occupation: Director, Creative Operations
jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Clinical Trial Planning
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Overview

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Trial Planning is an individual contributor focused on supporting Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) in the effective management of clinical trial timelines across the portfolio. The role drives planning system enablement (Planisware), owns and maintains a standardized Microsoft Project (MSP) trial planning template, and develops high-quality timeline visualizations to support trial execution and governance decision-making.

The role partners closely with Global Trial Leaders (GTLs), who are accountable for the overall delivery of their trials and retain ownership of trial timelines within internal planning systems. The Clinical Trial Planner complements this accountability by ensuring planning data is structured, standardized, and translated into clear, actionable insights that enable effective execution and decision-making.

**Responsibilities/tasks

****Planisware Enablement & Trial Support

**

• Partner with GTLs across the portfolio to drive effective use of Planisware and ensure trial plans reflect agreed assumptions, dependencies, and execution strategy, while GTLs retain overall accountability.

• Liaise with Development Program Managers (DPMs) to align trial-level plans with program- and asset-level timelines and milestones.

• Collaborate with the Portfolio Planning team to provide structured trial-level insights and recommendations that inform ongoing refinement and maintenance of Planisware templates and standards.

**MS Project (MSP) Template Ownership & Standardization

**

• Develop and maintain a fit for purpose Microsoft Project (MSP) Trial Planning template for GTL use across study phases.

• Ensure alignment between the MSP template, Planisware, and portfolio-level planning standards.

• Provide guidance to GTLs to promote consistent, high-quality timeline development using the MSP template.

**Data Visualization

**

• Develop and deliver clear visualization templates derived from Planisware and/or MSP data, displaying key milestones and activities.

• Tailor visual outputs to support CTTs, governance, and leadership discussions.

**Process & Tool Adoption

**

• Act as a Planisware subject matter expert at the trial-support level.

• Reinforce GTL training through hands-on guidance and real-time coaching.

• Apply and promote standardized planning methodologies and visualization standards across the portfolio.

**Governance Awareness & Decision Support

**

• Prepare timeline views and supporting materials aligned with governance forum expectations (e.g., Project Board, Portfolio Board, Operational Review Committee).

• Anticipate governance triggers based on timeline changes or emerging risks.

• Translate planning data into concise, decision-ready visuals and summaries.

**Requirements/Preferences

****Senior Manager

**

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Approximately 7-10+ years of experience in clinical trial operations, project management, trial planning, or related roles.

• Demonstrated experience driving planning system adoption and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience developing or standardizing planning templates, tools, or reporting frameworks across multiple studies.

• Strong understanding of portfolio-level planning considerations and governance expectations.

• Advanced analytical capability and ability to provide structured execution insight to leadership forums.

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$131,040.00---$196,560.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Test Manager, Defence
jobs.description:
As our new Test Manager, you will play a key role in delivering our SitaWare and Iris suites, an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset that helps Defence customers make critical decisions wherever they need it. You will apply your broad test and engineering skills in an agile environment with highly skilled colleagues, as part of our growing Defence Services team in Copenhagen.

The job

Our SitaWare and Iris suites give armed forces an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset spanning radio, mobile, vehicle, web and application-based solutions, with real-time reporting back to command HQ. As our new Test Manager, you will be involved in everything from the start of a feature, writing test cases and managing the process, through to verifying the final testing before we deliver the solution to our Defence customers.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning and conducting acceptance tests (FAT and SAT) with customers, both at our own facilities and at customer sites

• Conducting integration tests with third-party software and hardware

• Challenging solution design against risks, based on system context, customer requirements and security

• Taking part in military exercises to support the use of our solutions and find new ways of testing that reflect real-life use

• Establishing and maintaining test environments, and contributing to tender and proposal work on test and test management approach

You should expect travel within the Nordics, and potentially elsewhere in Europe, several times a year.

Joining the team

You will join a small but growing team in a brand-new office in the heart of Copenhagen, working closely with your Nordic colleagues while also collaborating with other teams across our global constellations. Testing is an integral part of our development process, and you will be part of a wider community of testers and test managers, with knowledge-network events to exchange ideas, hear lectures, share best practice and get to know your colleagues. It is an agile, fast-moving environment with flexible, trust-based working hours and plenty of room for personal responsibility.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A technical degree, Bachelor's or Master's

• Solid experience as a Test Manager or in a similar role, with strong technical skills

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail and Jira, including the Xray and R4J plugins

• Hands-on experience with test execution in close cooperation with stakeholders, and the ability to analyse and communicate technically complex solutions

• Solid knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, SQL/MS SQL Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals (IP, TCP, UDP, multicast, routing, firewalls), along with scripting skills in PowerShell or Bash

• Fluent Danish and English

• The ability to understand product requirements and translate these into effective tests

Alongside this, we value:

• Enjoys working in a changing environment, eager to step outside your comfort zone to make a difference

• Highly motivated to develop and apply your technical skills in a broad, technical role

• Enjoys customer-facing activities such as presentations, technical support, training and testing, building the trust that drives customer satisfaction

• Self-motivated and committed, with a hands-on approach

ISTQB or TMAP certification, automated testing experience, or experience with testing standards such as ISO/IEEE 29119, ISO 25010 or ISO 9001 are an advantage.

Experience with radio networking (e.g. VHF, HF) or tactical communications systems is a strong plus.

jobs.occupation: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Join Connected Cars on our mission to connect millions of car owners with their vehicles by tapping into the on-board diagnostics available in every modern car.

About Connected Cars

Connected Cars is on a mission to transform how automotive manufacturers and distributors interact with their customers by turning vehicle data into loyal, lasting relationships. By 2030, our vision is to turn vehicle data into timely, personal moments that build trust and drive loyalty, while streamlining operations and boosting efficiency across the value chain.

Our team consists of around 70 people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, brought together by a shared belief in team effort, community, and delivering quality products and solutions.

The Position

We are currently using Node.js (mainly TypeScript), Kubernetes, MySQL, and BigQuery on the backend, hosted on Google Cloud Platform. Having scaled our backend to a global presence, we rely heavily on Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. We believe in releasing early and often, supported by an automated CI/CD pipeline running multiple daily deployments.

Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams of 3–4 people with minimal overhead and bureaucracy. We empower our teams with full decision-making power over how they work, what they focus on, and how they deliver functionality.

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will architect and build robust APIs, backend services, and databases, while taking full ownership of your code from development to production monitoring (via Grafana and Google Cloud Monitoring). You will collaborate closely with other internal engineering teams and periodically communicate with external stakeholders to align on technical integrations and requirements.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a skilled, autonomous engineer with 5+ years of professional backend experience who possesses an inquisitive mind and thrives on taking full ownership of complex problems. You are driven, enthusiastic about software engineering, and proactive in figuring out what needs to be built. Beyond technical execution, you enjoy working cross-functionally and act as a supportive mentor within your team to help colleagues find effective solutions.

Key qualifications and experience:

• 5+ years of experience as a backend engineer building scalable systems.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and building RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and managing large datasets (terabytes in BigQuery or similar).

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and effectively communicate with external stakeholders.

• High degree of autonomy, problem-solving drive, and a natural curiosity to explore new technical solutions.

• Passion for high-quality code, TDD, CI/CD, and mentorship.

Our team is made up of people who genuinely enjoy the process of building things. If you have a GitHub account, a side project, or open-source experience, we’d love to hear about it.

Why Connected Cars

• A collaborative, innovative work environment that encourages growth, ownership, and technical autonomy.

• Competitive salary package and an attractive pension scheme.

• Friday bars, monthly social events, an affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited snacks in the office.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Please send your application through LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. It is not necessary to provide a cover letter, but feel free to if there is extra information you think we should know.

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Ready for the next step?

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

About Dalux

Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

jobs.occupation: Director, Application Management
jobs.description:
About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Application Management, you'll build the capabilities Hemab needs to run its business and regulated systems reliably as we grow. Working within IT & Digital, you'll take ownership from solution selection through implementation and ongoing management, making sure technology works for the people who depend on it.

You'll have room to shape how Application Management works at Hemab, deciding what we need now, what can wait and where external partners make more sense than building internally.

What you'll do

• Lead business system implementations from business case and solution selection through go-live, adoption and ongoing management.

• Turn business needs into practical technology solutions that fit Hemab's priorities, architecture and stage of growth.

• Own vendor selection, including RFI/RFP activities, solution evaluation and recommendations.

• Manage implementation partners and application vendors, holding them accountable for delivery, quality and service.

• Work with business owners to make sure systems, controls, training and ways of working are ready before launch.

• Establish application lifecycle management covering performance, upgrades, changes, renewals and vendor relationships.

• Partner with System Owners and Quality to keep regulated and GxP applications compliant and appropriately controlled.

• Build change and release management capabilities, using external specialists where appropriate.

• Work across Quality, Information Security, Data & AI, Legal and IT Operations to make sound technology decisions and build internal capabilities as Hemab grows.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Experience leading enterprise application implementations from selection through adoption and ongoing management.

• Experience working with regulated systems in biotech, pharma or another regulated life-sciences environment.

• Practical knowledge of GxP requirements, system lifecycle management and the controls needed to maintain compliance.

• Experience managing application vendors, implementation partners and outsourced services.

• Evidence of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects while managing competing business needs.

• Ability to work with senior stakeholders, make clear recommendations and take accountability for delivery.

Nice to have

• Experience helping a biotech scale from early clinical development towards later-stage maturity.

• Experience building an Application Management function or introducing new ways of working.

• Experience establishing change and release management using external partners.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

• Driving key elements of our compliance programme across business ethics, data protection, confidentiality and AI governance, including internal audits

• Excellent written and spoken English

• A responsible, curious approach to AI and new technology.

Life at NNE.

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Buying Trainee
jobs.description:
Buying Trainee

Wheat is one of the leading Scandinavian fashion lifestyle brands for children. We are passionate about creating clothing, footwear and accessories that combine timeless design, comfort, and responsible production.

For more than 25 years, we have designed products with great care and attention to detail. Our collections build on a long-standing Danish design tradition, where our most important signatures are high quality and longevity.

We are committed to doing business responsibly — balancing people, planet and profit — and continuously working to reduce our environmental footprint while creating products made to last.

Today, Wheat is powered by an international team of 50+ colleagues with headquarters in our office in Gentofte (Greater Copenhagen), and local offices or showrooms in Munich, Hamburg, Oslo and London.

We believe that diversity of perspectives strengthens creativity, innovation and decision-making — and we strive to build a workplace where everyone feels respected, included and able to contribute.

About the role

Have you recently graduated and are you ready to learn buying and product development from the ground up at an international children’s wear brand? We are looking for an analytical and curious trainee to join our Buying & Supply Chain team on a two-year traineeship. We imagine that you come from a programme at EK – Copenhagen Business Academy – or similar.

You will be based at our Head Office in Gentofte, report to our Chief Supply Chain Officer and work closely with Design, Sales and Supply Chain. You will be an active part of the buying team and help build our collections – from planning, costing and negotiation to orders and delivery.

You will have real responsibility from the start, but you will not be on your own. The traineeship is a learning programme where you work on real decisions for our collections with guidance and feedback from experienced colleagues – and your responsibilities grow as your skills do.

Your two-year traineeship

The traineeship bridges the gap between your education and a career in buying. Over two years, you will put what you learned in your studies into practice and gain a solid understanding of the full value chain – from first sketch to finished collection in the hands of our customers.

• 
In the first part of the programme, you will get to know our business, processes and seasonal calendar, and take part in the entire buying process – from collection planning and costing to order placement and follow-up.

• 
As you progress, you will take ownership of a product group or selected suppliers. You will lead the dialogue on prices, quality and lead times, and contribute to decisions on assortment and buying quantities.

• 
Along the way, you will work with our requirements for responsible production, certifications and product safety – and see how they shape our choice of suppliers and materials.

We follow your development closely throughout the programme with regular check-ins, so you know what you have learned and what comes next.

What you will work with

1. Planning & analysis

• 
Learn to analyse sales and sell-through data and use it to plan collections, assortment and buying quantities.

• 
Prepare costings and assess prices, margins and costs together with the team.

• 
Follow the season’s budget and key figures, and point out deviations and opportunities.

2. Suppliers & negotiation

• 
Maintain ongoing dialogue with our suppliers on prices, quality, order confirmations and lead times.

• 
Take part in price negotiations and help assess and develop our supplier base.

• 
Work with certificates, test reports and other documentation as part of our work on responsible production and product safety.

3. Collection & orders

• 
Be involved from collection meetings to finished order, working closely with Design and Sales on assortment and priorities.

• 
Place and manage purchase orders, making sure quantities, prices and data are correct in our systems.

• 
Manage samples and the seasonal timeline, and make sure deadlines are met across teams.

About you

You are curious about the business behind the products and enjoy combining numbers, products and people. You take ownership, keep track of the details without losing the big picture, and want to have a say in what ends up in the collection. We imagine that you:

• 
Have recently graduated – or will soon – from a relevant higher education programme, e.g. Design Technology (ideally with a specialisation in Fashion Management), a Bachelor in Design & Business, or a Bachelor in International Sales & Marketing from EK or similar.

• 
Are analytical and confident with numbers, Excel and costings.

• 
Work in a structured way and take ownership of your tasks from start to finish.

• 
Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and spoken. Danish is a plus, but not a requirement.

• 
Enjoy negotiating and thrive in contact with suppliers and colleagues across many countries.

• 
Take initiative and can prioritise between several tasks and deadlines at once.

• 
Are interested in products, fashion and responsible production.

Experience from an internship or student job in buying, fashion or lifestyle is a plus, but not a requirement. We value your motivation, curiosity and willingness to learn.

What we offer

• 
A two-year traineeship with real responsibility in buying and product development at a growing international brand

• 
Guidance and feedback from experienced colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge

• 
Increasing responsibility and influence as your skills develop

• 
Insight into the full value chain – from design and sourcing to sales and delivery

• 
A warm and collaborative work environment where well-being, trust and professional development are priorities

• 
Salary and employment terms that reflect a traineeship position

At Wheat, we believe great work happens when people feel safe, valued and supported. We aim to create an inspiring workplace where professionalism and kindness go hand in hand.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you are excited about the role but don’t meet every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

The traineeship is full-time and runs for two years. We hope to welcome our new trainee as soon as possible.

If you are interested, please send your application and CV in English or Danish to job@wheat.dk, marked “Buying Trainee”.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found — so don’t wait to apply.

jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. As demand for data centre infrastructure, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring continues to grow, we are expanding our capabilities to develop the next generation of sensing solutions.

As our Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will strengthen our mechanical engineering expertise within R&D and play an important role in developing future sensing platforms, with a particular focus on gas sensing and data centre applications.

You will help transform new ideas into robust, manufacturable products by driving mechanical architecture and packaging development from early concepts through industrialization. You will also provide technical expertise across mechanical design, packaging, and manufacturability while working closely with colleagues across multiple engineering disciplines.

This is an individual contributor role without people management responsibilities. Instead, your impact will come through technical leadership, influencing engineering decisions, sharing best practices, and strengthening our mechanical engineering capabilities.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You will lead mechanical development activities across innovation and new product development projects, ensuring solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading the mechanical architecture and design of next-generation sensing platforms, including housings, packaging, mounting concepts, and system integration.

• Developing robust encapsulation, sealing, and environmental protection solutions for sensors operating under demanding industrial conditions

• Driving mechanical work packages in innovation and product development projects in close collaboration with sensing specialists, electronics, firmware, manufacturing engineers, product management, and external partners.

• Developing mechanical concepts for gas sensing and data centre applications, including thermal management, fluid interfaces, installation concepts, and system-level solutions.

• Supporting prototyping, design reviews, risk assessments, testing activities, and supplier collaboration to enable successful industrialization.

**What We're Looking For

**You have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering combined with hands-on product development experience. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex mechanical challenges while collaborating across engineering disciplines.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

• Extensive experience developing industrial products from concept through production, including complex mechanical design challenges.

• Hands-on experience with mechanical design of sensors, electronic products, or other highly integrated mechanical systems.

• Strong experience with 3D CAD tools such as Inventor.

• Experience with injection-moulded components and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Also Have

**

• Experience with sensor technology and sensor packaging.

• Knowledge within areas such as sealing and joining technologies, thermal management, tolerance analysis, rapid prototyping, or high-volume manufacturing.

We recognize that great candidates may bring different combinations of experience and expertise. If you believe your background can contribute to developing our next generation of sensing solutions, we encourage you to apply.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will join a highly skilled R&D environment working on technologies that contribute to safer, more energy-efficient, and more sustainable solutions across a broad range of applications.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.
